signals.thesis: TSM at $441.40 (+4.1%) near its 52-week high ($450) amid the AI-semis melt-up (NASDAQ +3.07%, Nikkei +4.99%). The world foundry leader makes every major AI accelerator. Options flow is heavily bullish across ITM/OTM calls. RSI 59.4 leaves room, price +9.8% above EMA50 (under the 20% cap), +30% above EMA200. Given the +4.1% session, entry favors an intraday VWAP pullback over chasing the gap.

SMH closes at an all-time high ($647, +4.4%) led by NVIDIA/TSM/AVGO/AMD — diversified exposure to the day's leading theme without single-name risk. RSI 65 below overbought. Extension is real (+22% above 50-DMA) but it is a broad ETF at ATH in the strongest theme; the large put OI ($380-465) is structural hedging, not smart-money short. Pullback entry after the +4.4% session, stop below EMA20 ($593).

Santander breaks its 52-week high ($13.30) at $13.14 (+2.1%) on a fresh AmericanBulls BUY (Jun 11) and bullish MACD cross. The Spanish bank benefits from the European value re-rating: rising ROTE, capital returns, LatAm + Europe footprint. Forward P/E ~10x is cheap. RSI 63 healthy. Entry on the breakout zone, stop below EMA20. Bank = non-Sharia (interest income).

CSX consolidates just below its 52-week high ($48.03) at $47.39 (-0.4% today, healthy pause). Eastern US rail benefits from re-industrialization, intermodal volume and restored pricing power. RSI 60.4 with EMA20>EMA50>EMA200. Very tight ATR (2.0%) allows a close stop at the -3.0% floor with 1:1.9 R/R. Entry near spot since it did not run today. AmericanBulls BUY Jun 2.

stressScenarios.description: Fed rate hike +100bps: equities fall via ERP compression, bonds reprice
Equity market crash -20%: beta-adjusted drawdown across all positions
VIX spike to 40: volatility repricing, equity decline proportional to vol exposure
Crypto crash: BTC -30%, altcoins down more, minimal equity impact
Geopolitical crisis: risk-off flight to safety, equity decline, gold/USD rally
